claims.type: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∃ net : Network N (firstWidth N) (secondWidth N), ∀ x, net.eval x = Maximum N x
∀ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r → ∀ x, (network r).eval x = Maximum (r + 1 + 1) x

∀ {r : ℕ}, 2 ≤ r → (ParamidGeom.germDiff (fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => (1 : ℝ)) (Caterpillar.formula r - ParamidGeom.hS (ParamidGeom.simplexVerts (r + 1))) ∈ ParamidGeom.LSpan (r + 1) (r - 1)) → ∀ u, ParamidGeom.germDiff u (Caterpillar.formula r - ParamidGeom.hS (ParamidGeom.simplexVerts (r + 1))) ∈ ParamidGeom.LSpan (r + 1) (r - 1)

∀ {r : ℕ}, 1 ≤ r → (∀ u, ParamidGeom.germDiff u (Caterpillar.formula r - ParamidGeom.hS (ParamidGeom.simplexVerts (r + 1))) ∈ ParamidGeom.LSpan (r + 1) (r - 1)) → Caterpillar.formula r - ParamidGeom.hS (ParamidGeom.simplexVerts (r + 1)) ∈ ParamidGeom.LSpan (r + 1) r
∀ {s : ℕ}, 1 ≤ s → ParamidGeom.germDiff (Caterpillar.coordinateOne s) (Caterpillar.formula (s + 1)) - Caterpillar.valueFormula s ∈ ParamidGeom.LSpan (s + 2) s
∀ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r → Caterpillar.formula r - ParamidGeom.hS (ParamidGeom.simplexVerts (r + 1)) ∈ ParamidGeom.LSpan (r + 1) r
∀ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r → Maximum (r + 1 + 1) ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (↑(dictionary r) : Set (Point (r + 1 + 1) → ℝ))
∀ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r → ∀ x : Point (r + 1 + 1), ∑ i : Atom r, coefficient r i * atom r i x = Maximum (r + 1 + 1) x
∀ (r : ℕ), (Caterpillar.Corrections.normalizedWordCones r).card ≤ coneCount (r + 1 + 1)

∀ (r b : ℕ), 1 ≤ r → (Caterpillar.Corrections.normalizedWordCones r).card ≤ b → ∃ net : Network (r + 1 + 1) (firstWidth (r + 1 + 1)) (b * 3 ^ r - (r + 1 + 1) * (r + 1) + 2), ∀ x, net.eval x = Maximum (r + 1 + 1) x
∀ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r → ∃ net : Network (r + 1 + 1) (firstWidth (r + 1 + 1)) (secondWidth (r + 1 + 1)), ∀ x, net.eval x = Maximum (r + 1 + 1) x
∀ (N : ℕ), firstWidth N ≤ (N + 1) ^ 2
∀ (N : ℕ), 1 ≤ N → firstWidth N ≤ 4 * N ^ 2
Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun N : ℕ => (firstWidth N : ℝ)) (fun N => (N : ℝ) ^ 2)
∀ (N : ℕ), 3 ≤ N → coneCount N ≤ N ^ (4 * N)
∀ (N : ℕ), 3 ≤ N → secondWidth N ≤ 2 * N ^ (5 * N)
Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun N : ℕ => (secondWidth N : ℝ)) (fun N => ((N ^ (5 * N) : ℕ) : ℝ))
∀ (N : ℕ), 3 ≤ N → Real.log (secondWidth N) ≤ Real.log 2 + ((5 * N : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log N
∀ (N : ℕ), 3 ≤ N → Real.log (secondWidth N) ≤ 6 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log N)
Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun N : ℕ => Real.log (secondWidth N)) (fun N => (N : ℝ) * Real.log N)
Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun N : ℕ => (firstWidth N : ℝ)) (fun N => (N : ℝ) ^ 2) ∧ Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun N : ℕ => Real.log (secondWidth N)) (fun N => (N : ℝ) * Real.log N)

∀ {N h₁ h₂ : ℕ} (T₁ : Affine N h₁) (T₂ : Affine h₁ h₂) (T₃ : Affine h₂ 1) (x : Point N), (MaxCaterpillar.Internal.ofLayers T₁ T₂ T₃).eval x = (ReLUNet.layer T₁ (ReLUNet.layer T₂ (ReLUNet.affine T₃))).eval x 0
∀ {N h₁ h₂ : ℕ} (net : Network N h₁ h₂) (x : Point N), (MaxCaterpillar.Internal.toReLUNet net).eval x 0 = net.eval x
∀ {N h₁ h₂ : ℕ} {f : Point N → ℝ}, Width.TwoLayerWidth N h₁ h₂ f ↔ ∃ net : Network N h₁ h₂, ∀ x, net.eval x = f x
∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], Maximum N = MAX N
∀ (N : ℕ), coneCount N = Caterpillar.Corrections.spineConeBound N
∀ (r : ℕ) (x : Point (r + 1 + 1)), (network r).eval x = (Caterpillar.compactEssentialNetwork r).eval x 0
